title: Shim-unwind migration concierge and release sync for API model tag cutover
creator: Aisha Verma
description:
Purpose: define a lean, cross-functional playbook that coordinates the technical removal ("unwind") of the API compatibility shim for legacy model tags and provides a concierge service for customers during the cutover window. This ticket centralizes launch tasks: documentation, release notes, canary cadence, cross-team sync schedule, automated compatibility checks, regression telemetry dashboards, and a prescriptive migration concierge workflow for high-impact customers.

Scope: shim unwind for model-tag compatibility layer only (not feature flags or SDK surface changes). Includes:
- Release notes & small-batch GTM assets
- Scripts to detect usage of deprecated tags and generate customer lists
- A/B canary plan and rollback criteria
- Concierge outreach plan for top-50 customers who use legacy tags
- Migration guide, quick-fix snippets, and an SDK helper to auto-map select legacy behavior

Out of scope: major SDK breaking changes requiring semantic code updates, platform-level infra rewrites beyond lightweight routing fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted, reviewed by Eng, Docs, Support, and Legal and published to release-notes/redwood-api-v3
Automated scanner identifies active legacy-tag usage and outputs prioritized customer list (top-50) with contact owner
Canary run (internal) completes with defined SLO checks and no major regressions over 48h
Concierge outreach kit (email templates, migration checklist, troubleshooting playbook) available in Drive and linked in support runbook
SDK shim-unwind helper PR merged and published in npm with migration examples
Rollback playbook validated with a rehearsal (traffic shift back) and signed off by SRE and Eng
Customer-facing migration doc and 1-pager published and linked in release notes
